chapter: Recent years and early piano influences
title: Changes to midtown and New York work
summary: The Piccadilly Hotel is demolished, work is scarce, and foreign pianists arrive.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: How the music business changed: hype, youth and lost apprenticeship

blocks.x: Oh, has it? I didn't know that?
Yeah, you can't find it. There's nothing left. Did you see all those derricks?
What are they going to do with it?
Built an important(?) hotel. A big hotel. And it's supposed to be a park or something. They're trying to beautify Broadway.
Oh, that's interesting. Well, what is the state of the business like in New York now?
Well, there's not enough work. People are coming from all over now. All the English piano players are here. I think I'd better go there. Not only England; they're here from Taiwan -- everywhere.
Yeah, Japanese musicians are playing on the West Coast.
That's right. I heard that from fellows who are working in California. (?)ing them back. There seems to be a turnback.
